runners_data.name: Tuscan Point
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with excellent recent form including a win, proven at this trip and surface combination

runners_data.name: Beelzebub
runners_data.note: Hold-up type carrying bottom weight, headgear back on suggests trainer expects better effort than recent runs

runners_data.name: Andalprofit
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form and good course record, needs clear run in sprint finish

runners_data.name: Starsong
runners_data.note: Proven pace-setter with recent good form, tactical speed advantage in weak pace scenario but aging performer

runners_data.name: Melissa Honey

races.paceDynamic: Fenlander and Starsong are the only two horses with pace-setting credentials in this nine-runner field. With Fenlander returning from a 135-day break but showing prominent pace tactics, and Starsong coming off recent good form with proven early speed, they'll likely set a steady tempo without excessive pressure. The remaining seven runners all have hold-up styles, creating a tactical race where the pace-setters may get an easy lead before a wall of closers arrives late. This race shape strongly favours the early pace, as sustained pressure is unlikely and the leaders can dictate terms.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Fenlander and Starsong establish an uncontested lead through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows them to save energy for the finish while the hold-up brigade faces traffic problems in the sprint home. Front-runners can kick clear before the closers get organized.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Cavalry Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling slow
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get ideal conditions with a strong finish, but they still need clear runs and good positioning from their riders. Good Earth and Tuscan Point have the class to capitalize if they avoid trouble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Pressure Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses press forward earlier than usual to avoid being trapped
scenarios.body: This creates genuine pace throughout the race, suiting horses with tactical speed who can travel strongly. The race becomes more honest but still favours those who can position close to the action.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Tactical Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys misread the pace and create a stop-start rhythm with multiple moves
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where positioning matters more than ability, potentially suiting any horse who gets the perfect trip. Traffic problems will be decisive in this small field sprint finish.

Fenlander's 135-day absence could see fitness fail in closing stages despite tactical advantage

runners_data.name: Just A Girl
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with moderate recent form, 155 days off but has tactical speed to lead

runners_data.name: Loblolly
runners_data.note: Natural leader with solid standard going form, Jack Callan's 5lb claim valuable at bottom weight

runners_data.name: French Affair
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in excellent recent form, well-suited to this trip and has strong course record

runners_data.name: Henry Halflight
runners_data.note: Sharp prominent runner, excellent standard going record and trainer in good form recently

runners_data.name: Come On Eibhlin
runners_data.note: Prominent style but notably fades in finish, 163-day absence is major concern for stamina

runners_data.name: Wetsand
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with class advantage, consistent at this trip but carries top weight burden

runners_data.name: Gold Queen Kindly
runners_data.note: Hold-up style racer, needs pace collapse scenario but has shown ability on similar going

races.paceDynamic: Just A Girl and Loblolly will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a genuine gallop over this 7f trip. French Affair, Henry Halflight, Wetsand and Come On Eibhlin will track prominently behind the pace battle. The dual speed will create opportunities for prominent racers who can position well early, as the two leaders may compromise each other's finishing kicks. This pace scenario clearly favours prominent racers who can avoid the early speed battle while staying close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Girl and Loblolly engage in a sustained speed duel through the first half-mile
scenarios.body: The two leaders will weaken significantly in the final furlong, allowing the prominent racers to sweep past them late. French Affair and Henry Halflight are perfectly positioned to capitalise on this likely scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Girl or Loblolly establishes a clear advantage and gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The surviving leader can control fractions and prove difficult to peg back, especially with their proven ability at this trip. Just A Girl's superior recent form gives her the edge if this unfolds.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the field spreads out significantly
scenarios.body: Colori Forever and Gold Queen Kindly can use their hold-up style to deliver strong finishing kicks past tired leaders. The flat Southwell track suits this patient approach when the pace is honest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Win
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes modest with the two leaders settling too easily
scenarios.body: A shrewd prominent racer can steal a march and dictate terms from the front of the chasing pack. Wetsand's class advantage could prove decisive in this tactical scenario.

watchPoints.text: Just A Girl and Loblolly both break quickly and establish clear early positions as the pace will determine the entire race shape
Come On Eibhlin's jumping and early position given her tendency to fade and long absence from competition
French Affair's positioning behind the leaders as she has the form and style to benefit most from a speed duel
Colori Forever's ability to get into contention given the lengthy 162-day break and hold-up running requirements
Henry Halflight's jump from the stalls as his prominent style needs to avoid being trapped behind the pace battle

Ladies Day Sunday 16th August Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: City Queen
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with sustainable pace but may be vulnerable to tactical speed of prominent runners after 26 days off

runners_data.name: Selection
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with strong course record, well-suited to tracking the leader under Jason Hart

runners_data.name: Song N Dance
runners_data.note: Classy prominent runner returning after 155-day break but excellent recent wins suggest readiness to strike

runners_data.name: Pendella
runners_data.note: Progressive three-year-old with tactical speed, perfectly placed to exploit any weakening of the front runner

runners_data.name: Likeness
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner but may struggle from widest draw and carrying 123lbs after recent efforts

runners_data.name: Kiss Me My Love
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs a strong pace to be effective, recent poor form a major concern

races.paceDynamic: City Queen will be the sole natural leader from the start, setting a comfortable gallop with no immediate pressure. Selection, Song N Dance, Pendella and Likeness will all track prominently behind City Queen in the early stages, creating a decent-sized group within striking distance. Kiss Me My Love will be held up at the rear as the only confirmed hold-up performer. This race strongly favours the prominent runners who can position just behind City Queen and strike when the pace lifts, as the uncontested leader may be vulnerable to well-positioned challengers in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group can stay in touch with City Queen's steady gallop
scenarios.body: The race will develop into a tactical affair where positioning matters more than raw speed, allowing the likes of Selection, Song N Dance and Pendella to use their tactical speed. These prominent runners get the perfect trip tracking the leader without being headed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If City Queen gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows City Queen to dictate throughout and have enough left to repel late challenges. Her recent consistent efforts at this trip on similar going give her a strong platform.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Kick Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop is too steady and the field comes together late
scenarios.body: Kiss Me My Love can use her hold-up style to devastating effect if the race becomes a sprint finish. The tactical nature allows her to pick off tired leaders despite her moderate recent form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If City Queen goes too slow and gets swamped turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where any horse can win regardless of running style. Form and class become less relevant as positioning and luck dominate the outcome.

watchPoints.text: City Queen may get uncontested lead - watch if she's allowed to coast through early splits unchallenged
Song N Dance returning after 155 days - monitor if she travels with her usual fluency in the early stages
Selection has strong course form - note if Jason Hart can secure ideal prominent position behind City Queen
Kiss Me My Love needs pace to aim at - watch if early gallop is too sedate for her hold-up style to be effective
Pendella dropping back to one mile - observe if this shorter trip suits her tactical speed better than recent longer efforts

races.name: Country & Western Night 25th April Handicap

runners_data.name: Holly Mist
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse trained by in-form Roger Varian but faces a tactical disadvantage with so many others employing similar tactics in this small field.

runners_data.name: Union Island
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with prominent style perfectly suited to exploit the lack of pace pressure from a field full of hold-up horses.

runners_data.name: Marry The Night
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong recent form including three wins, but Tim Easterby's poor 14-day record is concerning despite the horse's obvious ability.

runners_data.name: Soames Forsyte
runners_data.note: Experienced hold-up horse whose recent Southwell win shows he handles the track, though faces the same tactical issues as other closers.

runners_data.name: American State
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with a recent win but Ivan Furtado's poor strike-rate and the tactical squeeze from behind makes this tougher.

runners_data.name: Hachiman
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer from Ruth Carr's struggling stable with just nine days between runs, adding to the traffic concerns for back-markers.

runners_data.name: Dream Illusion
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent recent form including two wins, but carries a 3lb claimer and faces the tactical nightmare scenario like other closers.

runners_data.name: Looks Fantastic

races.paceDynamic: Union Island will lead from the front with Looks Fantastic potentially tracking early, but the bulk of this field comprises hold-up horses who will settle behind a modest pace. With six of eight runners preferring to come from off the pace (Holly Mist, Marry The Night, Soames Forsyte, American State, Hachiman, Dream Illusion), the early tempo will be restrained. The lack of pace pressure on Union Island creates a tactical scenario where the leader can dictate terms comfortably. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the large contingent of hold-up horses in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady tempo
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Union Island to string out the field and kick clear when challenged, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from their backward positions. This scenario rewards the pace-setter who can control the race from pillar to post.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large group of hold-up horses encounter trouble in running or get caught wide
scenarios.body: Six horses trying to come from behind creates a bottleneck in the straight, allowing those with better positions or cleaner runs to prevail. The superior recent form horses like Marry The Night and Dream Illusion can capitalise if they get clear runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island's tempo proves too slow and multiple horses quicken simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the final two furlongs where class and finishing speed determine the outcome rather than tactical positioning. Recent winners Dream Illusion and Marry The Night have the form edge in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites neutralise each other through traffic problems or tactical errors
scenarios.body: A horse like Soames Forsyte or American State, with proven ability but less obvious chances, finds the gaps that elude the market leaders. Their hold-up style suits if the pace is genuine enough to set up their finishing kicks.

runners_data.name: The Lakes
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner will get uncontested lead but very low ability rating suggests he's vulnerable

races.paceDynamic: The Lakes will set a steady, comfortable gallop with no pressure from a small field predominantly made up of hold-up performers. With only one confirmed front-runner in The Lakes (OR 6), and the rest being hold-up horses except for two unknowns (Poppeye and Mystic Music), the pace will be pedestrian through the early stages. The lack of speed will build into a sprint finish as eight runners converge from off the pace in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike, rather than pure hold-up horses who may find themselves with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If The Lakes sets uncontested fractions with the field bunched behind
scenarios.body: The pedestrian gallop turns into a cavalry charge where positioning and a turn of foot matter more than pure ability. Higher-rated horses with any tactical pace will have decisive advantages over pure plodders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Unknown Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Poppeye or Mystic Music show early speed to pressure The Lakes
scenarios.body: A stronger gallop favours the proven hold-up horses who can finish off a true pace. The higher-rated hold-up performers get their optimal conditions with something to aim at.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Field Collapse Behind Leader
scenarios.trigger: If The Lakes builds an uncatchable lead while the field marks each other
scenarios.body: The front-runner steals it in a slowly-run race where nobody goes after him early enough. Late closers find they've left themselves with an impossible task.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems in Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent gets bunched and blocked in the straight
scenarios.body: Poor positioning and traffic issues decide the race more than ability ratings. Horses drawn favourably or ridden more aggressively early avoid the problems.

watchPoints.text: The Lakes gets too easy a lead early as the field allows him 10+ length advantage through the first mile

Pure Moon's fitness after 164 days off as Tom Clover horses often need their comeback runs
How aggressively the hold-up horses are ridden early, as passive tactics could prove costly in a slowly-run race

runners_data.name: Silkies Sib

runners_data.name: Arth's Gold

races.paceDynamic: Lednikov stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the start. With no pressure from other pace horses, he can set sustainable fractions through the early stages of this 1m4f contest. The large field of hold-up horses including Jack Andrea, Silkies Sib and Arth's Gold will bunch up behind, creating a cavalry charge finish. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a turn of foot in the final 2-3 furlongs when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Lednikov sets modest fractions and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The pace will be pedestrian for 10 furlongs before exploding in the final quarter-mile, suiting horses with a decisive finishing kick. Hold-up specialists with proven acceleration will have the tactical edge over those needing to race prominently.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Lednikov Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner maintains a workable advantage and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: With no early pressure, Lednikov can conserve energy and prove difficult to peg back if he finds extra gear approaching the final furlong. His recent Southwell win suggests he handles the track well and stays this trip strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Lednikov goes too fast early or ties up in the straight
scenarios.body: A muddling pace followed by Lednikov's capitulation would create a messy finish where any horse finding rhythm late could prevail. This chaotic scenario would suit horses coming from furthest back with strong staying power.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Drive Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine throughout and becomes a test of stamina
scenarios.body: Should Lednikov go faster than expected or other horses track closer, it becomes a staying test favouring horses who grind out results rather than relying on sharp acceleration.

watchPoints.text: Lednikov must be monitored early - if he goes faster than expected it transforms the entire race dynamic and favours stamina over speed.
Jack Andrea's price movement given his excellent recent form and strong Hector Crouch booking for in-form John Butler yard.
Sycamore Gap's market support despite 558-day absence - any confidence would be significant given Stephen Hanlon's poor recent record.
The pace through the first half-mile will determine everything - modest fractions favour hold-up horses while genuine pace suits grinders.
Apprentice riders on Lednikov and Late Claim handling the tactical demands of this trip under pressure in a competitive handicap.
